transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to Riverside Sports Centre. My name is Dan, and I'm the manager here. I'd like to tell you about the centre before you start your first session.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: The centre opens at six thirty every morning, Monday to Friday, and closes at ten at night. At weekends it opens at eight and closes at six. The swimming pool is on the ground floor, and the gym is on the first floor. If you are a new member, you can have a free introduction to the gym equipment. Just ask at the front desk, and one of our trainers will show you how to use the machines safely.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: We have a range of classes. On Monday and Wednesday evenings there is a yoga class at seven o'clock. On Tuesday there is a spinning class, which is very popular, so you must book in advance. Thursday is for badminton, and there is a beginners' session at eight. We don't have a class on Friday, but the pool is open for families.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Membership costs thirty-five pounds a month, or three hundred and fifty pounds for the whole year. If you pay for a year, you save seventy pounds. Students and people over sixty-five get a discount of twenty per cent. You'll need to show your student card or your passport when you join.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Now, a few rules. Please wear clean shoes in the gym, and bring a towel, because we don't provide them. There are lockers in the changing rooms. They cost one pound, but you get the coin back when you open the locker. Don't leave valuable things there, though, because the centre isn't responsible if anything is lost. Children under twelve must be with an adult in the pool at all times.

transcript.speaker: S1
transcript.text: Finally, there's a café on the first floor, next to the gym. It serves hot drinks, sandwiches and salads, and it's open until eight in the evening. If you have any problems or suggestions, please speak to a member of staff, or write in the comments book at the front desk. Enjoy your visit!
